policy: Keep one condition question per semantic opportunity family, not every possible pair.
Exact same public CPU operator may emit multiple kernels for necessary implementation reasons. Kernel count/name equality alone never proves duplicate work, legal removal or latency gain.
Cumulative native durations are not critical path latency; startup cold operations do not rank formal C8 steady-state bottlenecks.
Module routing is an evidence index; alternatives are not duplicate work to be summed. No whole-module utilization ranking or branch closure follows from a source ancestor.
